payload.description:
As a downstream maintainer, I want Tactus package metadata to avoid unnecessary provider/extras explosion during install, so that pip resolves quickly and deterministically.

Feature: Stable Tactus dependency metadata
Scenario: Resolve Tactus transitively in downstream project install
Given a clean Python 3.11 environment with modern pip
When pip resolves dependencies that include tactus
Then resolver does not backtrack across large unrelated provider stacks
And installed dependency versions remain compatible with downstream constraints
And no temporary downstream transitive pin block is required for basic install success
payload.title: Define dependency-resolution behavior for Tactus published metadata
